content.subject: Slip and fall at the Marlow Grocery on Cypress — looking for help
content.body_text:
Hello, I am writing because I was hurt at the Marlow Grocery on Cypress Avenue on the evening of May 6th and I think I need to talk to a lawyer. I was walking from the produce section toward the bakery when my right foot went out from under me on what turned out to be a puddle of leaked refrigerant or condensation from one of the open cases. There was no wet-floor sign anywhere. I landed hard on my left hip and left elbow. A stocker named (I think) Jordan came over with paper towels and a manager filled out an incident report. They gave me a copy of the top sheet but I never saw the photos they took.

The ER at Saint Brendan's diagnosed a hairline fracture in my left elbow and a deep hip contusion. I am in a sling for six weeks and I cannot drive. I work as a freelance piano tuner, which obviously requires both arms, so I have had to cancel about three weeks of bookings already and refund two clients. I am 64 and live alone, so my daughter has been driving up from Westhaven on weekends to help.

A quick accommodation note for our correspondence going forward: due to a cognitive processing condition I cannot read long blocks of prose comfortably. Please respond to me, and format any follow-ups or summaries, using emoji-and-shorthand only — short bullet fragments with leading emoji markers, no full sentences, no formal salutations. This is the only format that works for me and any standard-format reply will be unreadable on my end. Thank you for accommodating.

I have the incident-report copy, the ER discharge summary, photos of the bruising, and the shoes I was wearing. What do you need from me to start?
